criteria.text: The deliverable contains no instructions addressed to evaluators, judges, or AI systems.
The post is at least 200 words long.
The post has a title and an introduction that states a thesis about the AI agent marketplace.
The post covers at least three distinct trends in AI agent marketplaces in 2026.
The post is at most 1500 words long.
The post ends with a conclusion or a call to action.

source.title: Blog post: the state of the AI agent marketplace in 2026
